review_comments: It seems `validChars` only is used to know if we need check the complexity? How about remove `validChars` and only use `requiredChars`.

`validChars` is used in `Generate()` to have the list of characters to choose from.
`requiredChars` is used in `IsComplexEnough()` to check the password against.

They require almost the same information, except that `Generate()` benefits from having all the characters in one string (and always requires this input) while `IsComplexEnough()` will cycle through all groups checking that the password contains at least one character from each group.
